summary: Frontend-only test of Smarter Select All and the Gas Bottle Log (TankChange Gas tab), with Fuel/Water regression. Everything requested works. Select All shows on normal skipper lists (Pro myTodo, custom_1793042167417, leavingDock, arrivingDest). It is hidden on shipsLog, mayDay, panPan and Crew Roles (tpl_test67crew), and on every list for crew (free user on the shared Pro boat c_test-user-pro_main: myTodo, custom list, riggingChecks, mayDay, shipsLog; the items still render as toggles). Gas tab works on departure (tank-change-gas) and arrival (arrive-tank-change-gas). The unit label says 'bottles' and the hint shows the spare count. Empty or 0 gives 'Enter how many bottles.'. Swap 1 logs exactly as specified. With 2 bottles in use, level 1/2 and a swap of 1, the level moves to Full and the text ends 'Gas in use now Full.'. Swap 3 with 2 in use gives an error and nothing is logged. Added 2 logs '...estimated weight added 18 kg (gas 9 kg plus about 9 kg of bottle)... Spare bottles now 2.' and gas_extra becomes '2' in the DB. Removed 1 brings it to 1, and it persisted after reload. Remove 5 with 2 spares gives 'There are only 2 spare gas bottles on board.'. Remove with 0 spares gives 'There are no spare gas bottles on board to take off.'. Neither error logs anything. With units ft and gas_kg 9, weights show in lb (99.2 lb, 39.7 lb, 119 lb). With gas_bottles blank, a swap has no upper limit and does not change the level. Fuel regression: empty amount gives 'Enter how many litres.'. 20 L added at 1/2 on a 100 L tank logs 'Fuel added 20 L (diesel), estimated weight added 16.8 kg ... Tank now about 70 L of 100 L (3/4).' and the picker moves to 3/4. Water 10 L logs with 10 kg. At 390px there is no horizontal overflow (scrollWidth 390); on the gas row, Swapped sits beside the input and Added/Removed wrap to a second row. At 1920px all three fit on one row.

ui_bugs.issue: Typing '1.5' keystroke by keystroke drops the '.' silently and leaves '15' (COUNT_RE rejects only the dot). A user who expects half a bottle could log 15 bottles by accident. Consider showing a hint/error on a non-digit key, or blocking the whole edit.

The hint says '(the gas level above goes up)' whenever a gas level is picked, even when gas_bottles (bottles in use) is blank. In that case gasChange returns level null and the level does not change, so the hint is misleading.

issues: The row wraps unevenly: 'Swapped' sits beside the input and 'Added' and 'Removed' drop to a left-aligned second row. It is usable with no overflow, but a 3-button full-width row under the input would look tidier.

action_items: Optional: show the '(the gas level above goes up)' hint only when num(boat.gas_bottles) > 0 as well as levels.gas
Optional: give feedback when a decimal is typed into the gas bottle count, rather than silently dropping the '.'
Optional: CREW_ROLES is /^crew roles$/i (exact match), so copies like 'Crew Roles 2' or 'Crew Roles - Sample' still show Select All. Widen it if 'named like Crew Roles' should include these
critical_code_review_comments: gasChange lb rounding: the total is rounded separately from its parts, so 39.7 lb shows next to 'gas 19.8 lb plus about 19.8 lb' (sum 39.6). This is cosmetic.
With units ft, the bottle size still reads '9 kg each' / 'of 9 kg' while the weights are in lb. That is probably fine because bottles are sold by kg, but note it.

TankChange calls onSet and onBoatChange in the same handler. For gas these are mutually exclusive (swap sets the level, add/remove sets gas_extra), so there is no stale-state overwrite today. Keep it that way if both ever fire together.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested checks passed (3 low-priority polish items)
